goal: A shared per-player rate limiter every RemoteEvent handler can use, so a client that spams a remote is refused on the server rather than trusted. A caller asks whether a player may act now, and the limiter answers yes or no.
acceptance_criteria: A ModuleScript at src/shared/RateLimiter.luau returns a constructor taking a limit and a window in seconds.
The returned object has an Allow function taking a Player and returning a boolean, annotated with an exported type.
A player at the limit is refused until the window passes; state for a player is dropped when they leave.
No polling loop: time is read when Allow is called, never on a heartbeat.
Every file begins with --!strict and the whole project passes scripts/verify.ps1.
notes: Keep it small: one module, under 120 lines. A short answer is a correct answer more often.
Return only the files you create. Do not return DataService.luau or any file you are not changing.
